title: 22 St John Street: August project report
body: The building launched to the market in August and the lettings campaign is under way, with enquiry led by professional-services occupiers.

tasks.title: Launch
tasks.detail: Launch event held on site on 14 August; the show suite is now open for viewings.

tasks.title: Show suite handover
tasks.detail: Fit-out, decoration and furnishing complete; handed to the lettings team.

tasks.title: Suite lettings
tasks.detail: Viewings under way across all floors, with the first offers in negotiation.

title: Barnett House: August project report
body: Design development for Tabula continues ahead of a start on site, with contractor procurement running in parallel.

tasks.title: Design development
tasks.detail: Detailed design progressing, with the existing building surveyed and incorporated.

tasks.title: Contractor procurement
tasks.detail: Two-stage tender issued to a shortlist of three; returns expected in the autumn.

tasks.title: Funding
tasks.detail: Senior terms agreed in principle against the funding appraisal.

title: The Courthouse: July project report
body: All thirteen apartments are complete and the sales campaign continues, with reservations converting to exchange through the summer.

tasks.title: Building handover
tasks.detail: Common parts complete and the building fully commissioned.

tasks.title: Sales
tasks.detail: Reservations and exchanges progressing across the thirteen apartments, handled by the in-house team.

tasks.title: Distributions
tasks.detail: First distribution forecast for December as sales complete.

title: Hazelgate: July project report
body: The project team has reconfirmed practical completion for September following the latest programme review, keeping the scheme ahead of the original date.

tasks.title: Programme review
tasks.detail: Practical completion reconfirmed for September, three weeks ahead of the original date.

tasks.title: Apartment fit-out
tasks.detail: Kitchens and bathrooms installed to the first and second floors; snagging begins in August.

tasks.title: Sales and marketing
tasks.detail: Reservations open, with viewings handled directly by the Satis Group team.

title: Davenport Park: July project report
body: Davenport Park is complete, with the final homes handed over and the scheme performing in line with the business plan.

tasks.title: Practical completion
tasks.detail: Achieved, with all homes handed over.

tasks.title: Final account
tasks.detail: Agreement of the final account with the contractor under way.

tasks.title: Distributions
tasks.detail: June distribution paid; the next is forecast for January.

title: Barrington House: July project report
body: The building is complete and letting well, with residences and en-suite rooms marketed through Rightmove and SpareRoom.

tasks.title: Occupancy
tasks.detail: Lettings progressing across the en-suite rooms and apartments, with strong local demand.

tasks.title: Snagging
tasks.detail: Residual snagging closed out floor by floor.

tasks.title: Income
tasks.detail: Rental income building towards the stabilised business plan.
